Commentary.Commentary: Before the collapse happened, we witnessed a few stands with the century partnership between Aiden Markram and Hashim Amla being the best. Debutant Zubayr Hamza also showed good promise in his knock while de Bruyn was another batsman to get a start. At one stage, they were cruising and the hosts seemed destined to post a big first innings total but then they completely lost the plot and fell apart. Pakistan's bowling was very ordinary in the first two sessions but then led by Mohammad Amir and Mohammad Abbas, they managed to run through the South African middle order. Faheem Ashraf with a 3-fer also had a good outing. Stay tuned for Pakistan's reply.

A mega-collapse courtesy some exceptional reverse swing bowling by Pakistan. They were looking down and out after the first two sessions but then made a resounding comeback. It all started with the wicket of Theunis de Bruyn and then it was a procession. The African lower half failed to stand up and they got bundled out well under 300.

OUT! South Africa are all out for 262! Excellent stuff from Pakistan post Tea. Faheem bangs one short on middle and leg, Olivier goes for the hook but gets a top edge to it. The ball flies towards Abbas at fine leg who gets low and takes a safe catch. 7 wickets for 33 runs, has to be one of the most stunning comebacks in the game.
On a good length on the off pole, Duanne taps it to the off side.
YORKER! Touching 140 kph. The number 11 does well to get bat on it. Survives!
Back of a length ball aimed at the hips of Olivier who tucks it away on the on side.
Back of a length on middle, Steyn defend it from within the crease.
Bumper on middle, Dale evades it at the last moment.
Yorker from Ali on leg stump, Steyn makes room again trying to drive it. He does not get any connection and the ball goes to the keeper. Hasan Ali appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Back of a length on middle, Steyn backs away and tries to slog it but misses it completely.
Length delivery on middle, Steyn flicks it to mid-wicket.

Short of a length on middle, Steyn tries to defend it off the back foot. It rises off the deck after pitching, hits Steyn on his arm and the ball goes straight to the keeper. An appeal from Hasan, but the umpire is not interested.
Similar delivery, same result.
Bouncer from Ashraf, the batsman ducks underneath it.
Low bounce. A touch fuller outside off, Olivier tries to defend it off the front foot, but the ball keeps low after pitching. Luckily for Olivier it was not on the stumps.
Short of a length on off, Olivier lets it go.
Duanne Olivier is the last man in for South Africa.

OUT! Quinton de Kock tries to cut loose but holes out! Cannot be faulted for attempting that shot but it's his bad luck that he finds the fielder with precision in the deep. A back of a length delivery around off, angling away, de Kock attempts to heave it over the mid-wicket fence but it takes the toe end of his bat and goes straight down the throat of Mohammad Abbas. He makes no mistake and South Africa's last recognized batsman is out of here. 6 wickets for 33 runs, talk about collapsing!
Drags it short and wide down leg. QdK need not play at those.
In the air but safe! The off cutter from Ali. Steyn does not pick it as he tries to check his shot. Ends up chipping it in the vacant square leg area for a run.
On the shorter side again, Steyn stands tall and works it to mid-wicket.
A bumper this time, Steyn may have been surprised by it, he lays down flat on the ground and avoids it.
Shortish and outside off, the batsman guides it through point. There is protection in the deep so only a single.
Change of pace there. It is on a length and around off, de Kock tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On the shorter side, de Kock is hurried into the pull shot. He mistimes it to mid on.
Nicely driven! Fuller in length on off, Steyn strokes it to mid off.
BEATEN! That was a poor shot by Steyn. It is bowled around off, it pitches and then moves away. Steyn hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
Short and outside off, Steyn slashes hard but the ball goes past his outside edge.
Good length again and this one is angled into the batter. Steyn somehow blocks it out.
On a length and around off, Steyn defends it off the back foot.
Outside off, Steyn gets bat to ball and it rolls towards covers.
A good short ball on the body, Quinton de Kock is a touch late on the pull shot. It goes off the gloves towards fine leg for a run. Faheem has also overstepped.
Fuller on middle, Steyn drives it to mid on.
Full and on off, Steyn strokes it through covers for a couple.

Drinks break. Pakistan continue to dominate proceedings post Tea and the reverse swing has reversed their fortunes for good. South Africa are reeling now and need their lower order to partner Quinton de Kock if they want to get past the 300-run mark.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Two in two overs for Hasan Ali. Another full delivery does the trick. This one also swings away from the left-hander. Rabada goes for a booming drive through the off side, the ball takes the outside edge and Sarfraz behind makes no mistake.
Similar delivery, Rabada guides it straight to the gully fielder.
Length delivery on off, Kagiso taps it towards point.
Back of a length delivery on off, Rabada tries to defend it from the crease but it goes past the outside edge of the bat.
FOUR! Drags it short this time on middle, de Kock gets into position early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Good end to the over for the Proteas.
Length delivery on middle, Quinton tucks it to on side.
Fuller on middle, the batsman drives it straight to the mid on fielder.
A touch short on middle, Quinton tucks it to the leg side.
FOUR! Good shot! Strays on his pads, de Kock flicks it through square leg and the ball races away to the boundary.
Fuller on off, de Kock drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Back of a length around off, Rabada defends it onto the ground.
Kagiso Rabada is the next man in for South Africa.

OUT! Three reds and Philander has been given the marching orders. Did not see that coming but excellent use of the technology from Pakistan. They haven't been great with the DRS in recent times but this time they have got it spot on. Sarfraz will be a delighted man and the good period of play after the Tea break continues for Pakistan. Good passage after the ball has started to reverse, I must say. Hasan Ali is amongst the wickets now. It is full and on middle, tails back in. Philander plants his front foot across but then tries to adjust to the movement and flick. He misses and it hits him on the pad. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Sarfraz signals the 'T'. Replays show that the on-field call has to be overturned, we all thought it would be missing or at the most clipping the leg pole but it is hitting. Hmm... 300 now looks farfetched.
A huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down. Pakistan have reviewed it. Philander is the man in question. Seems to be slipping down leg.
Good bowling from Ali. Just outside off stump. Tempting Philander to go after it. Vernon lets it go.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle, VP drives it straight to the bowler.
On the 5th stumps line, Philander shoulders arms to it.
Fuller on off, Vernon pushes it towards point.
Fuller on off, Quinton keeps it out.
Length delivery on leg, de Kock tries to flick it but misses it and is hit high on the pads. The appeal is turned down.
In the channel outside off, Quinton shoulders arms to it.
Fuller on off, QdK defends it with a straight bat.
Wide outside off, Quinton lets it go.
A tad short outside off, de Kock cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
Play and a miss! Back of a length delivery on off, Philander tries to punch it through point but misses it completely. Good end to the over for Ali.
Fuller on middle, Vernon defends it off the front foot.
On the 5th stump line, left alone by Philander.
In the channel outside off, Vernon lets it go.
Fuller on middle, VP tucks it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Starts his new spell with a length delivery on middle, Philander defends it off the back foot.
Hasan Ali is on.
Back of a length on off. De Kock chops it down towards point.
Drifting on his pads, Quinton flicks it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Amir is now seen walking off the field. Faheem Ashraf will complete his over. Not good this for Pakistan, he was amidst a brilliant spell. They will hope it is not serious.
Full on middle, Vernon works it to the leg side for a single. Amir is down on the ground as soon as he released the ball. He is in some discomfort here.
Length delivery on middle, Philander watchfully defends it.
Fuller on off, Vernon drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Back of a length on middle, Philander defends it off the back foot.
Similar delivery, the batsman keeps it out.
Fuller this time on off, de Kock pushes it towards point.
Length delivery on middle, de Kock defends it from within the crease.
On a length and on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
A touch short on off, de Kock cuts it towards point.
Fuller on middle, de Kock times it sweetly but straight to the bowler.
Vernon Philander is the next man in for the Proteas.

OUT! Amir gets another, he is on fire here. Let me repeat - Another batsman misses out on a milestone. This time it is the debutant who falls 9 short of a fifty. The indecision has cost him. Amir continuous to bowl it in the channel of uncertainty. Hamza first thinks of playing at it but then at the very end, tries to leave as it is angling away. It is though too late by then. The ball takes the bottom part of the bat and goes into the gloves of Sarfraz. South Africa have lost their way completely, from 229 for 3, they have slipped to 244 for 6. Pakistan into the lower order.
A touch fuller on middle, Hamza drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Fuller on middle, de Kock pushes it to mid on for a single.
Similar delivery, the batsman cuts it straight to the point fielder.
A touch short on off, de Kock chops it towards point.
Fuller this time from Amir on middle, de Kock watchfully defends it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length on off, Hamza defends it from within the crease.
Fuller on middle, the batsman pushes it to mid on for a quick run.
Length delivery on off, de Kock defends it with a straight bat.
Full on leg, the batsman tries to flick it but is hit high on the pads. Too high!
On a length and on middle, de Kock defends it off the front foot.
Similar delivery, same result.
Fuller outside off, Hamza drives it towards point.
Fuller on middle, Hamza defends it with a straight bat.
NO BALL! Amir oversteps. Drifting on his pads, the batsman tucks it around the corner for a single.
A tad short on off, de Kock punches it through point for a couple of runs.
Back of a length on off, de Kock defends it from within the crease.
Beaten! Back of a length on middle, the ball tails back in sharply after pitching. De Kock tries to defend it off the back foot but it goes between his bat and the pad.
A touch wide outside off, Hamza drives it towards the point fielder.
Fuller again on off, Hamza tries to defend it from the crease but gets an inside edge on it and then onto the pads.
Good delivery, that. On a length and on middle, Hamza watchfully defends it.
Fuller delivery tailing back in a bit, Hamza tries to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge on it and the ball rolls towards the leg side.
Length delivery on middle, the batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller delivery outside off, Hamza drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Quinton de Kock is out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Amir gets his man. He probed and probed and probed and this time, has found the edge he was looking for. A well-deserved wicket for Amir and Bavuma's uncomfortable stay out in the middle has come to an end. Once again it is the late movement which causes the problem. Amir pitches it on a length around off, it shapes away. Bavuma this time plays inside the line. The ball kisses the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper. Amir is ecstatic and Pakistan have got two quickly. They are right back into the contest.
This is perfect bowling! On a length again, this time though it has been defended solidly.

NEARLY! Three lovely deliveries from Amir but luck is just not going his way. Third consecutive ball which is pitched on a length. Bavuma plays outside the line, it hits the inner half, then hits the pad and rolls agonizingly close past the off pole.
BEAUTY! You can just hope that does not hit the edge! Back of a length around off, it pitches and shapes away. Bavuma is once again squared up as he tries to defend, this time he gets beaten.
Squared him up! Length again and on middle, it pitches and straightens. Bavuma tries to defend but gets squared up, he misses and it hits him high on the pads.
Good running! This is worked to the right of mid on. The batsmen scamper across for a single.
FOUR! Two boundaries from the over along with a wicket. Drifts on his pads, Bavuma clips it off his pads through fine leg for a boundary.
On middle, Temba defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! SHOT! Bavuma is off the mark with a sublime boundary. It was a touch full on middle, Bavuma leans forward and drives it firmly through the covers for a boundary.
On a length and on middle, Bavuma tries to defend it off the front foot, but gets an inside edge and it hits him on the pads.
Temba Bavuma is the next man in for the Proteas.

OUT! Plumb in front! Reverse swing happening and Abbas has struck. Theunis departs one short of his fifty, not the first batsman in this innings to miss out on a milestone. Great nut by Abbas. He bowls a length delivery with the shine on the inside. It's around middle and off as de Bruyn tries to work it on the leg side. But due to the late inward movement, he misses the ball completely to get rapped on the pads. They appeal vociferously and this time the finger has gone up. Quite plumb. Theunis walks back without even thinking of reviewing the decision. End of the 75-run stand!
On a length on middle, de Bruyn defends it with a straight bat.
Good length on off, Hamza once again is solid in defense.
On the middle stump, Hamza gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
BEATEN! Excellent use of the angle there. He lands it on off which means Hamza has to play at it. The ball slants away beating the outside edge by a whisker.
Good length on off, Hamza comes forward and defends it.
Again it is a little too straight, de Bruyn flicks it towards square leg for another run.
On the pads, it is worked towards fine leg and a run is taken.
Mohammad Amir to bowl from the other end.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call it is, Pakistan though do not lose their review. It is on a length on middle, Theunis tries to flick it but is late on it. The ball hits him on the front pad. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Sarfraz goes for the review. The replay shows it was just clipping the top of the stumps. Pakistan have started really well after Tea.
Review time! A screaming appeal by Abbas for an lbw. Not entertained. Sarfraz is convinced and takes the DRS. Looks a bit high. Let's wait and watch...
Back of a length on middle, de Bruyn defends it from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller on middle, Hamza works it to the leg side for a single.

DROPPED! On a length and on middle, the ball jags back in sharply after pitching, Hamza tries to defend it but it hits the inside edge of the bat and the ball goes towards Sarfraz. He dives to his left and tries to catch it but cannot hold onto it. This could prove a costly drop as de Bruyn is looking in good touch.
Starts off with a length delivery on off, Hamza defends it off the back foot.
The players are out in the middle. Zubayr Hamza will take the strike. Mohammad Abbas will start the proceedings after Tea.
.... Day 1, Session 3 ....

Theunis de Bruyn in the company of debutant Zubayr Hamza has taken the Protea score beyond the 200-run mark and the pair is amidst a 72-run partnership. It has come in a quick time as well. Pakistan were very poor since the fall of Amla's wickets as they conceded runs at a brisk rate. They will have to come back strongly in the last session otherwise the home team will run away with the show. Do join us in a short while.

Another fine session of Test cricket! South Africa were pegged back early when Aiden Markram was strangled down the leg side but then Hashim Amla and Theunis de Bruyn formed an alliance for a short period. Once the former got dismissed after a superb catch by Asad Shafiq, Pakistan would have sensed an opportunity to get an upper hand on this Test match. But that was not meant to be.
A flatter delivery to end this session. De Bruyn pushes it back to the bowler. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 1!
Deft! Hamza waits for it and then plays it very fine on the off side. The ball stops as it nears the fence and the batsmen take three.
On the stumps again, it is blocked out.
On middle, it is kept out.
FOUR! A half-tracker and Hamza is well-set to not put those away. He pulls it with disdain and into the square leg fence.
On the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Not in total control but a boundary nevertheless. Outside off, Hamza looks to cut it away but it goes off the outer half towards third man and meets the fence once again.
Leg spinner outside off, the debutant reads it well and leaves it alone.
Leg spinner outside off, Hamza gets behind it and sees it out.
Wrong 'un on off, Hamza gets an inside edge on the on side.
Loopy ball on off, carved away through point for one.
Short ball on middle and leg, de Bruyn pulls but cannot get it past mid-wicket.
On the stumps, it is kept out off the front foot.
Flighted ball on off, Hamza keeps it out.
An action replay of the last delivery.
Works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, it is pushed towards mid off for a quick run.
Tosses it up around off, the batsman lunges and blocks it towards point for a run.
Asad Shafiq is on now.
Tosses it up outside off, de Bruyn drives it crisply but straight to the man at covers.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On off, it is kept out.
Floats it up on off, de Bruyn drives it to covers.
The googly on off, TdB chops it to covers.
Slightly short and on middle, de Bruyn goes back and somehow pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
On off, Hamza gets behind it and blocks it out. Good over for the hosts. They have scored over 100 runs in this session, so far.
Fuller again on middle, driven to mid on this time.
Follows it with a quick single. Great stuff. Full and on middle and leg, de Bruyn hits it towards mid on and gets to the other end quickly.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over and they are coming thick and fast. Outside off, de Bruyn punches this through cover-point. The fielder chases it but cannot pull it off.
Length and closer to the stumps de Bruyn watches it go through to the keeper.

FOUR! SHOT! SA are scoring at ease at the moment. Wide outside off, de Bruyn flashes hard at it. Gets it past backward point and the ball races away to the fence. It also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Very full and on off, de Bruyn jams it out towards covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On the flatter side, de Bruyn tries to punch it off the back foot but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up on off, TdB blocks it out.
FOUR! Cut and it has been played nicely! Too many loose deliveries after the wicket of Amla. Short and outside off again, de Bruyn helps himself by cutting it through point. The ball races away.
On the shorter side around off, the batter stands tall and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Up and over! Short and wide and it has been put away. Hamza hops and cuts it over point. The ball races away to the fence.
Slightly short and de Bruyn works it off his hips towards mid-wicket for a run.
Length delivery around off, de Bruyn lunges and keeps it out.
Hits the length around off, de Bruyn shuffles across and works it to mid on.
On the shorter side around off, de Bruyn guides it to point.
Floated one this time, full and around off, Hamza strides forward and defends it right under his watchful eyes.
Too full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Zubayr has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy and full on off, Hamza drives but picks the cover fielder.
Flatter and shorter outside off, hit firmly in front of square on the off side for a run.
Full and flighted on middle, defended back to the bowler.

A huge appeal but not given! There was definitely a noise though. Another short ball and this is on the body. Hamza goes for the pull, there is a noise as the ball passes the gloves. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Pakistan decide not to review. Not sure from where that sound came. Ultra Edge shows there was no spike, so a good decision in the end.
Short again, gets it to bounce at a good height. Hamza hops and defends it onto the ground.
Better! This is bowled right on the off pole, Hamza prods forward and keeps it out.
Wide outside off again, the batter need not play at those.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Raining boundaries here! This time it is a cracking pull shot from the debutant. It is a high bouncer, Hamza gets on top of the bounce and pulls it all along the ground to the square leg fence.
FOUR! A boundary to start the over and one to end! Once again Shadab is guilty of bowling too short. De Bruyn goes back and pulls it right off the middle to the square leg fence.
On the shorter side outside off, de Bruyn cuts it to point. Shadab has been guilty of bowling either too full or too short in this over.
Very full on off, de Bruyn pushes it back to the bowler.
A low full toss on off, de Bruyn uses his wrists and works it to mid-wicket.
Gives it air and lands it on off, TdB pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Too short and it has been put away! Enough time for de Bruyn to go back and whip it through mid-wicket. It races away. He too joins the party, runs flowing here.
Back of a length on off, Hamza lets the ball come to him and then guides it to gully.
Now a short ball on middle, Hamza ducks under it quite easily. The new lad now looks at ease out there.
Goes fuller this time on middle, the batsman strokes it back towards the bowler.
Back of a length on off, Hamza defends it onto the ground.
Good length on off, Hamza defends it onto the ground.
A little too straight to begin with, it is worked around the corner for a couple. He moves onto 21.
Hasan Ali is back for another spell.
An extra slip fielder was brought in but Shadab bowls it very full, Hamza eases it down to long on for a single. Another productive over for South Africa. 20 have come from the last two.
Now floats this up on off, Hamza puts in a long stride forward and defends it onto the ground.

Nicely bowled and it is played even better! The googly outside off, it is slightly short. Hamza did not pick it, he first goes back to cut but the ball turns back in. Hamza then adjusts and guides it past the slip fielder. The fielder from point races after it, tries to stop it but can't do so. Hamza is managing to score quickly here.

SIX! He has picked the bones out of that one! What a hit! A hit-me ball by Shadab, short and on middle, Hamza rocks back quickly and then sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence. That made a cracking sound of the bat and the result too was an excellent one for the debutant.
Slower through the air on off, Hamza prods forward and keeps it out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Three runs now! This was right off the middle, it is on his pads, easy for Hamza. He flicks it through mid-wicket, the ball stops as it nears the fence. Three taken. Good over this for South Africa. Not what Pakistan would have wanted after Shadab bowled a tight last one.
A little bit of Rohit Sharma in that forward defensive stroke. Length and coming in with the angle. Hamza lazily lunges and at the very end brings his bat down to keep it out.

FOUR! First boundary for Hamza! It is not of the middle but he won't care. Fuller goes Amir after the last one being short. Hamza lunges and tries to drive it ahead of his body, it takes the outside edge and goes through backward point for a run.
Changes the angle and bowls the effort ball. It is short and on off, Hamza gets on top of the bounce and defends it down onto the ground.
Another single as de Bruyn works it against the angle towards mid-wicket.
First run for Hamza in Test cricket. This should settle his nerves. He taps this towards covers and scampers across for a run. A round of applause for him by the crowd.
Gives it air on off, de Bruyn lunges and blocks it out. A maiden by Shadab, a good one.
The googly outside off, it turns back in, not enough though to make the batsman play.
On off, it is kept out.
On the shorter side, de Bruyn pushes it to covers.
TURN AND BOUNCE THERE! This is tossed up around off, it pitches and then turns away. De Bruyn first thinks of playing at it but then pulls out seeing the bounce and turn.
The googly on off, de Bruyn goes back and pushes it to the bowler.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off, left alone.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full and outside off, de Bruyn tries to turn it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge towards mid off. A single taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

PITCHED OUTSIDE LEG! A length delivery which de Bruyn fails to work it on the leg side. He takes a blow on his pads and they put in an unsuccessful appeal. Sarfraz opts for the DRS but the replays show that it's pitching outside leg. End of discussion. Also, it's going over the stumps. Review lost.
Huge shout for an lbw! The umpire turns it down and Sarfraz Ahmed goes for the DRS after having a little chat with his bowler. Let's see....
De Bruyn has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A googly this time, around middle and turning down, Hamza fails to work it around and is hit on the thigh pad. End of a wicket maiden by Shadab!
Full and flighted outside off, Hamza drives but finds the cover fielder.
Debutant's time to rock now! It's Zubayr Hamza in next.

OUT! What a catch! Asad Shafiq shows brilliant reflexes at first slip. Hashim Amla will have to go. Another set batsman is dismissed. Shadab delivers a short one outside off, Amla rocks back to slap it square of the wicket on the off side but it takes a fat outside edge and hurries behind to Shafiq. He stretches to his right and snaps it quickly. Hashim misses out on a half century and this is a good passage of play for Pakistan.
Tossed up delivery outside off, once again left alone by Amla.
Flighted outside off, left alone.
Amla has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Theunis de Bruyn is looking very good and confident. It can be observed from the fact that he played two different types of shots to an identical delivery. One full ball outside off he tried to whip across the line while drove through the line when fed a similar ball again. Drinks time! Pakistan have picked up a wicket of Aiden Markram in the last hour but will have to build on it. Yet another partnership is blossoming now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Ouch! Sharp delivery that. A touch short on off, de Bruyn tries to leave it. The ball did not climb much as he was expecting. Hits Theunis on the chest.
Fuller delivery on off, Theunis pushes it to mid on.
Good length delivery just outside off, de Bruyn shoulders arms to it.
On a length on off, Theunis defends it with a straight bat.
Back of a length on off,  Hashim taps it towards point for a single.
FOUR! SHOT! Fuller on off, de Bruyn presses forward and times it sweetly through covers for yet another boundary in this over. Theunis has looked good in his short stay so far.
On a length on middle, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Similar delivery, Theunis shoulders arms to it.
Fuller delivery outside off, the batsman lets it go.
On middle, de Bruyn drives it straight to the bowler.
Back of a length on middle, Theunis defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Overpitched from Faheem, Theunis leans forward and drives it firmly through covers for a boundary. It's also called a no ball for overstepping.
Puts it on a length on off, Amla drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Once again length delivery outside off, Amla leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on off, Amla this time drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Tempting Amla to drive by bowling it outside off. Hashim is calm and shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, Amla doesn't disturb that one and lets it go.
Mohammad Amir is back on.
Length delivery on off, Amla blocks it away off his back foot.
A tad short on middle, Amla pulls it through square leg for a single.
Outside off, Hashim lets it go.
Fraction straight on middle, HA drives it straight to the mid on fielder.
A touch fuller on off, Amla defends it with a straight bat.

FOUR! Good improvisation. Length delivery on off, Amla at the last moment opens the face of the bat and guides it through the vacant third slip region and the ball goes towards the third man boundary.
Fuller delivery on off, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Theunis defends that one by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Good foot movement by de Bruyn.
Slightly fuller this time and de Bruyn blocks it off his front foot.
Once again length delivery this time on off and Theunis defends it away off his front foot.
Length delivery on middle, blocked off the front foot by de Bruyn.
FOUR! Beautiful! Fuller delivery by Abbas on off, de Bruyn gets to the pitch of it and hits straight behind the bowler. Abbas had no chance to save that one. A perfect straight drive by TdB!
Length delivery outside off, de Bruyn shoulders arms to it.
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot and it went on one bounce to the gully fielder.

Good calling! A length ball outside off, de Bruyn gets across the stumps and pushes it back. He knows how softly he has hit that and hence wants a run. Amla is initially ball-watching but then he responds and they complete the single with ease.
Fullish and on off, it's once again pushed back off the front foot by Theunis.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone with ease this time.
Lands it full and outside off, Theunis goes hard at it and hits it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Full and angling in around off, de Bruyn pushes it back and the bowler makes a good stop in his followthrough.

Fuller length delivery on off, de Bruyn pushes it to covers and calls for a quick single. The fielder misses the stumps at the non-striker's end and Theunis gets off the mark. A direct hit would have been interesting.
Length delivery on off, finds the outside edge of Theunis' defensive bat. Luckily he played it with soft hand.

Dangerous! A slightly fuller delivery outside off. De Bruyn offers no stroke to it and the ball jags back in after pitching to rap him on the pads. The Pakistan fielders appeals but the umpire is not interested. Sarfraz opts not to ask for the review as he thinks it was high.
Once again a length delivery on middle and off, de Bruyn blocks it off his front foot.
Beauty! Bowls it on length and the ball moves away after pitching and misses the outside edge of de Bruyn's defensive bat by just a whisker.
Length delivery on off and middle, Amla flicks it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Angling back into the batsman, de Bruyn flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it to covers.
Theunis de Bruyn is in next.

OUT! Markram is walking! What a disappointing end to a promising knock! Aiden is absolutely gutted with himself. He is strangled down the leg side. A delivery angling down, Markram tries to flick but gets a thin inside edge behind. Sarfraz flies to his left and takes an outstanding catch. They are appealing and Aiden Markram is seen walking. A good gesture. End of a wonderful knock, he deserved a century though. Pakistan needed this breakthrough desperately. The 126-run stand is over and the tourists would like to build on this.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Poor delivery by Ashraf and a great shot by Markram. Full length delivery on to the pads of Markram. He beautifully flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Markram into his 90's and looks on course to score a big century.
Length delivery on off, Markram blocks it off his front foot.
Faheem Ashraf is back on.
On middle and off, Amla defends this length ball from the crease.
Abbas seems to be in love with short deliveries. Hurls across another one, an easy leave for Hashim as he ducks.
Full and outside off, Amla uses his long approach and defends it to the off side. Very limited footwork.

Short ball on middle, at 125 kph, Markram pulls it down to fine leg and jogs across for a run. Realizes late that the throw is coming at his end and hence hurries. It misses the stumps at the bowler's end but the mid off fielder has it backed up.
Angles in a good length ball on middle, Markram closes the face of his bat as he flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Play and a miss! Abbas digs in a short delivery around off, Markram tries to hook it across the line but it bounces a tad extra and goes over his bat.

FOUR! Wonderful! Ali overpitches that one and Amla is too class a batsman to miss out on that one. He beautifully drives it through covers for a boundary. There are only a handful of batsmen who look as good as Amla when on song.
Length delivery on middle and Hashim blocks it by getting right behind that one.
Length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders arms to it. A bit of inswing movement after the ball hits the deck.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla tries to drive it to mid on but finds the inside half of the bat and the ball goes to the fielder at mid on.
Slightly short this time, finds the inside edge of Amla's bat and onto his pads.
Length delivery on off, Amla guides it to the fielder at gully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

A mishit! Aiden survives. Back of a length delivery on off at 125 kph, Markram hangs back inside the crease in an attempt to heave it across the line. But he fails to time his shot properly and it balloons in the air. Luckily for Markram, it flies over mid-wicket and lands safely in the deep. The batsmen take a couple.
Slower cutter this time, at 105 kph. It lands full and moves back in, Markram plays it late from the crease and defends it down.
Pitches it up and on off, Aiden drives it down the ground but straight to the mid off fielder.
Angles in a gentle length ball on middle at 123 kph, Markram flicks it off his pads but finds the fielder on the leg side.
Good length ball on off, Markram stays inside the crease in defense.
Length delivery on off, Hashim defends it off his front foot. Good over for South Africa, 8 runs off that one.

FOUR! Action replay of the previous boundary. Once again Ali bowls a bit fuller and Hashim once again drives the ball wonderfully through covers for a four. It's a joy to watch when Amla is timing the ball as beautifully as he is today.
Pulls back his length and Amla blocks it away by opening the face of the bat.
FOUR! Exquisite! Ali bowls it slightly fuller and Amla brings out his classic cover drive and finds the boundary. That's a textbook drive from Amla.
Length delivery on middle, Hashim blocks it off his back foot.
Amla defends it off the back foot by presenting the full face of the bat.
Finishes off the over by bowling a length delivery on middle, Aiden blocks it off his front foot. A good over by Abbas.
Fuller delivery on middle and leg and Markram drives it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length delivery and Markram defends it off his back foot.
Once again a fuller delivery and Aiden defends it off his front foot.
Fuller on this occasion and Aiden blocks it beautifully off his front foot.
Short of a length delivery by Abbas and Markram defends it off his back foot.
Amla shoulders arms to the delivery bowled outside off.
Amla blocks the fuller length delivery off his front foot.
Fuller delivery on middle, Markram drives it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully driven! Full delivery outside off, Markram gets on his front foot and beautifully drives it through covers for a boundary. He continues where he left off before lunch.
Once again a length delivery on middle, Aiden blocks it off his back foot.
First ball after lunch and Hasan starts with a length delivery on middle. Markram defends it off his front foot.
Welcome back. The afternoon session is about to begin. The men concerned are out in the centre. Hasan Ali will bowl the first over after Lunch.
... DAY 1, SECOND SESSION ...

Fabulous session for South Africa. They have scored in excess of 100 for the loss of just one wicket. Dean Elgar chose to bat but he himself didn't last long. Post that, the pair of Hashim Amla and Aiden Markram joined forces and it's been easy going for the Proteas. There was some initial help from the surface but the Pakistani bowlers weren't hitting the right areas. Also, the pace of their speedsters was quite down to trouble the batsmen, especially on a pitch which ain't offering excessive movement. Markram has shown extraordinary form so far and will be eyeing a big score. Amla has taken his time but he too will like to get a big score under his belt. So far, Pakistan have looked clueless and it will be interesting to find out how they respond post Lunch. Do join us in a short while.
Angles in a full ball on off, Hashim Amla strides forward and defends it with ease. That will be Lunch on Day 1.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A mistimed shot! Fullish and outside off, Amla reaches out for this one as he attempts to play the cover drive. But it takes the inner half of his blade and rolls back to the bowler.
Pitches it up and lands it outside off, Amla is in no mood to chase it.
Once again Amla moves across the stumps to a good length delivery and defends it on the on side.
Good length ball just outside off, Amla shuffles across and defends it near his front pad.
A googly this time, full and on off, Amla defends it back with a vertical bat.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Loopy and full on off, Amla leans forward and defends it.
Tossed up ball on off, Amla lunges and defense. There is a deep point and long off in place, a field set for poor bowling? Giving cover to Shadab for his short balls and full tosses. Hmm...
Short and spinning away, Amla cuts but finds the point fielder.
Full and flighted on off, Amla drives it back and the bowler dives to parry it towards short cover.
Fullish and on off, Markram defends it off his front foot to mid off.
Markram has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! That's beautiful! Just walks into his on drive. A full ball on middle at 126 kph, Markram presents the full face of the bat and caresses it through mid on for a boundary. 100-run stand comes up!
Slants in a full ball on middle and off, Aiden flicks it across the line but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Markram has nothing to do with it.
Full and angling in around off, right on target, Markram is forward in defense.
Mohammad Abbas is back for one final burst before Lunch.
Fuller again, a touch flatter through the air, landing around off, Hashim presses forward in defense. Shadab just rushed through his over, should take more time and think about his bowling.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it watchfully to the off side.
A loopy full ball outside off, Amla drives it to covers where Imam makes a diving stop this time.
Full toss again, it's been forced through covers for a run.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Starts with a low full toss on off, Markram drills his drive through the line and Imam at extra cover fails to stop the racing ball. Seems to have hurt his fingers there as it reaches the fence in a flash. Good start against spin for South Africa. 100 up for them!
Time for some leg spin! Shadab Khan has been introduced into the attack. A slip in place.
Aahhh...finds the fielder again, this is frustrating as a batsman. Short and wide outside off, Amla rocks back and cuts it firmly but finds the fielder.
Well fielded, Shadab! Saves a certain boundary. Amla plays a delightful cover drive to a full ball but fails to find the gap. Will be disappointed.

Markram is looking so good there. A length ball angling into the batsman, Aiden just presents a straight bat and pushes it wide of mid on. Hasan Ali chases it down and they take three runs. This is now the best partnership between this pair in Tests.

FOUR! The point fielder experiences a bad bounce. Fullish and outside off, Markram leans into the square drive and middles his shot pretty nicely. Imam tries to stop it but fails and it screams away to the fence.
On a length again, Markram goes on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Good length ball on off, shaping back in, Markram stays back and defends it to the off side. This one stayed low but Aiden always had his eyes on the ball.
The line again is straight and Amla taps it down to square leg. The non-striker wants a run but Hashim isn't interested.
A length ball on middle, Markram helps it just wide of wide mid on and steals a single. The fielder there misfields slightly as he attacks the ball.
Strides forward again, to a length ball this time as he defends it down safely.
FOUR! Elegant! Amir delivers it full and outside off, Markram leans into the drive and creams it with all the elegance in the world for a boundary at covers.
Mohammad Amir loses his footings and pulls out of his delivery stride at the last moment. Scratches the popping crease before heading back to his bowling mark.
Full this time, on middle and off, Aiden sticks inside the crease and defends it again.
Hits the bat hard. On a good length around middle, Markram offers a straight bat in defense.
Serves it on a fuller length outside off, it's been left alone by Hashim to complete the over. Nothing happening for Pakistan and this is just the second hour of this Test match. Ominous signs.
Fuller in length and outside off, Aiden pushes it to the left of the cover fielder. Shan Masood tries to stop it but fumbles slightly as he turns and the batsmen take a single.
Pitches it up and around off, Markram lunges and defends it with soft hands.
A touch short and around off, Aiden is on the back foot as he taps it down on the off side.
Fullish and outside off, skidding off the surface, Markram takes his front leg forward and then makes a leave.
Shortish on off, Amla punches it in the gap at covers. The point fielder runs across to his right to stop the ball and they cross.
Lands it on a length around middle, Markram defends it by covering the line.

FOUR! No margin for error on this pitch! Fractionally short and around leg, Markram picks it off his pads and flicks it past the square leg umpire for a boundary. Timing and placement, both top notch.
Aiden Markram pulls out at the last second. Maybe, some sightscreen issue. Amir will have to reload.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
A touch short and on off, Amla defends it easily off his back foot.
Closer to the off stump this time. On a good length, Amla stays on the back foot again as he defends it to the off side.
Slants across a length delivery outside off, a comfortable leave for Hashim who just sticks back inside the crease and sees it through.
Nice punch off the back foot. A good length delivery on off, Aiden pierces the gap at covers and collects a couple of runs. Easy going. This partnership is worth 73 now.
A length ball outside off, Aiden gets forward and defends it to the off side.
Shortish and on middle, Markram gets back and plays it down to mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Lovely shot! Just a push off the front foot but it has been timed superbly. Ashraf serves it on a fuller length outside off, Markram strides forward and strokes it through extra cover. Brings up his 5th Test fifty, just loves playing at this ground, he averages in the 60s at Jo'burg.
Fractionally short and on off, Markram goes on the back foot and punches it back to the bowler.
Nice delivery. Angling across Amla, around off and holding its line. The batsman takes a stride forward to cover his stumps and then shoulders arms.
Inside edge again. Fullish and on middle, Markram attempts to flick it in front of square leg but it gathers the inside edge and runs through backward square leg for a run.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it on the leg side.
Full and on middle, defended back off his front foot.
Good length ball on middle and off, Markram goes on his toes as he plays it down to mid-wicket.
Full in length around leg, Markram plays it straight off his pads towards mid on.
Mohammad Amir is back on.

Great stop, Imam! Fullish and outside off, Amla plays a full-blooded square drive but Imam stationed at point dives full length to his left to stop the racing ball. Superb effort, something Sarfraz likes to see from his boys.
Full and outside off, Amla defends it by getting forward.
Amla has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Nearly carries to third slip. Ashraf serves it on a length around off, Amla pushes inside the line with gentle hands again and this time it takes the outside edge. It though dies down quickly in front of Shadab.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length ball on off, defended back.

FOUR! Soft hands! A length ball outside off, Amla decides to stay back and pushes at it with an angled bat. He places it through the gap between gully and slips as it races away. It's also called a no ball for overstepping. Looking at the replays, it's a bit touch and go.

FOUR! My goodness, that's a great shot! This one is neither short nor full, Markram stays back and plays a short-arm jab through mid-wicket. A kind of shot that's difficult to play but the batsmen love to execute it.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Stays back-footed to a short ball and punches it down to cover-point.
Good shot! Hasan angles in a length ball and Amla just pushes it back with a straight bat. It races behind and by the time the mid off fielder pulls it back, they take three runs.

Not in control. Fuller and on middle, Markram tries to flick but it takes the inner half of his willow and travels to deep mid-wicket. There is a fielder stationed there already and hence only a run results.
Fuller length ball on middle, it's clipped through backward square leg for a run.

Similar good length on that fifth stump line. Markram looks to leave it but it late in getting his bat high. The ball takes the bottom edge of the bat and dies down. Maiden from Ashraf and two good overs back-to-back.
Length outside off, left alone by Markram.
A tad fuller this outside off, Markram pushes it to the off side.

An appeal which dies down. Good length ball on off, moves a bit away after pitching. Markram looks to play it with a straight bat but misses. Hits his back leg and Pakistan appeal. Nothing from the umpire.
This one is a bit back. On a good length on top of off, Adien stands tall and bunts it down.
Full and in line of the stumps, Markram gets behind it and blocks it well.
On a length and outside off, left alone by Amla to end the over.

Sarfraz ain't happy! Ali angles in a full ball on middle, Aiden closes the face of the bat and bunts it towards mid on. The fielder there is a bit lazy in reacting as the batsmen pinch a single. The Pakistan skipper screams in anguish.

Beauty by Hasan! He hurls across a fuller length ball outside off at 140 kph and it nips back in after landing. Markram tries to drive through the line but is beaten on the inside edge. There is certainly some spice in the surface and Pakistan have failed to utilize it so far.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under it at the last moment.
Back of a length delivery on off, Amla camps back and punches it in front of square on the off side. Three added to the total as the fielder pulls it back just before the rope. 50-run stand comes up.

Appeal for an lbw! Not given. A good length ball on off, shaping back in with extra bounce, Amla fails to keep it out and is hit on the flap of the front pad. Looked high as the umpire shook his head.

Drinks break. Done with the first hour of this Test match and South Africa have already moved to 54 for the loss of Dean Elgar's wicket. Apart from that moment in the second over, the Protea batsmen have looked at ease, especially Aiden Markram. He has raced to 39 and is batting with a strike rate of 75 at the moment. Hashim Amla has been more watchful though. For Pakistan, their pacers have been largely ineffective as they have not hit the right areas consistently. They need pull up their socks quickly and get it right in the next hour.
Uses his crease this time, the bowler. Goes wide of the crease as he lets in a length ball on off, Markram blocks it safely.
Full and on off, angling in at 135 kph, Aiden is forward in defense.
Markram shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Around off, punched off the back foot to covers this time.

FOUR! That's aerial and inches away from the diving gully fielder. Back of a length ball around off, Markram goes back to punch it through covers but it catches the outside edge speeds away to the fence. Amla walks up to his partner and probably has a word of advice for Markram.
Good length ball just outside off, at 130 kph, Markram stays back and taps it down to gully.
Faheem Ashraf is introduced into the attack.

FOUR! It appears Hasan Ali is more concerned about his foot landing in the danger area than where his ball is landing. It's nice and full outside off, this time Amla accepts the invitation and crunches his drive through covers. 50 up for South Africa.
Fullish and on off, Amla drives it down the ground but straight to mid off. It's a conscious effort by Hasan Ali to stay away from the danger area.
Good length ball targeting the top of off stump, Amla punches it from the crease but finds the cover fielder.
An inviting delivery outside off, Amla declines the offer of playing a drive off the front foot. He just remains back and allows it through to Sarfraz.
Lands it on a length and just outside off, Aiden stays back inside the crease and gently plays it down in the gap at covers. A single is pinched. All too easy for South Africa currently.
Pitches it up and around off, Markram defends it back by showing the full face of his bat.
Abbas puts it on a full length on off, Amla is half-forward in his defense.
Good length ball on off, this time Amla blocks it from the crease to the off side.
Full and on off, shaping back in, Amla allows it to come back in and then dead-bats it. Abbas' plan is to keep it full and around off and let Hashim play as many balls as possible by getting forward.
Amla has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angles in a fuller length ball outside off, Amla is watchful in his defense once more.

A length ball around off, Hashim is watchful in his defense. The way Markram is batting, it must be taking the pressure away from Amla. He can spend some time in the middle without thinking too much about scoring runs. Settle down first and then make merry.
That's the length. Hasan needs to hit this area more. Drops it on a good length around off and gets it to shape back in. Markram fails to defend but is hit high on the pads. Some inside edge also.
Wide called for height! A bouncer has gone all wrong. It travels well over the head of the batsman.

FOUR! This is T20 stuff! Hasan digs in a short delivery, Markram trusts the bounce, fetches it from outside off and powers his pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence. Early struggle for Pakistan. 12 from the over, so far.
A hint of inward shape from a length outside off, Aiden defends it near his front pad.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! And again. Back of a length delivery outside off, once again Markram is quick to ride the bounce as he punches it past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Shot! A touch short and outside off, Markram gets on top of the bounce and punches it sweetly behind point for a boundary. Good start to the over.

A length ball on off, cutting back in, Markram inside edges his attempted shot and it goes behind square leg for a run. We're done with the first 10 overs of the match and there hasn't been too much on offer for the bowlers. There is movement for the new ball but nothing very dangerous. Apart from losing Dean Elgar, South Africa have largely looked unperturbed.

Full and angling in around off, a little bit of swing there, Markram presents a straight bat in defense. Good contest going on. Just putting it there and waiting for the batsman to err in his shot selection.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This one is on the pads and Amla has easily flicked it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Pitches it up and outside off, Amla is on the front foot as he defends it to the off side. Hashim doesn't look too comfortable whenever he is drawn forward.
Full and angling in around off, straightening a bit after pitching, Amla defends it from the outer half of his bat to point.
Aiden has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Quality shot from a promising young man. Hasan Ali pitches it up and outside off, Markram confidently gets on the front foot and nails his cover drive for a boundary.
A length ball on middle, straighter in line again, Markram pushes it towards wide mid on.
Fuller in length on middle at 135 kph, Markram gets forward and works it off his pads to the leg side. Not in the gap though at mid-wicket.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
In the channel outside off, Markram leaves it easily.
Hasan Ali has the ball in his hand.
Stays back and plays it down in the gap at covers for a quick single. 11 from the over, South Africa going on nicely.
Back of a length delivery around off, nipping back in and staying low too, Markram tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! A short delivery at a gentle pace isn't a good idea but it almost worked. Abbas just wanted to surprise the batsman by altering his length. He puts it around off and Aiden immediately goes for the pull shot. Fails to middle it and ends up top edging it behind to fine leg for a boundary.
Edgy! Full and outside off, moving away a bit, Markram tries to defend but it takes a soft outside edge and rolls past gully for a couple.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Abbas overpitches outside off at 124 kph, Markram takes a big stride forward and drives it delightfully through covers for a boundary. The pace is too gentle here from Abbas, allowing the batsman to adjust.
Full and on off, angling in at 127 kph, Markram draws forward ind defense.
Good length delivery angling away from the batsman, it's outside off and Hashim lets it through to the keeper.
A real teaser around off, Amla makes a good leave. Looking a bit tentative whenever he has to press forward.

Nearly a catch at short leg! Good length delivery on middle, too straight in line, Markram rotates his wrists and flicks it uppishly past Shan Masood. It speeds away and Abbas also sprints across to his left from fine leg. Uses his boot to keep it out just before the rope and the umpire finds it a clean effort after consulting it upstairs. Three added to the total.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

A bit like the last delivery, this time Markram gets on top of the bounce and plays it down to short leg. Shan Masood keeps his eyes on the ball and collects it on one bounce. Good quality to possess for a bat-pad position.
Extra bounce on this occasion. Jumping onto the batsman from a shortish length on middle. Markram tries to play it out but fails and takes a blow on his body, near the stomach area.
A length ball on off, Hashim walks across the stumps in his stance and defends it on the leg side.
Puts it on a fuller length on off, Amla gets forward and across before blocking it with a dead straight bat. Not shuffling across too much like he used to, has worked on his technique it appears.
An easier leave on this occasion. Full and outside off, trying to tempt the batsman into a drive, Amla is patient enough to allow it through.
Good leave. Abbas takes a length ball into the batsman with the angle and then it straightens after landing just outside off. Amla covers his stumps by shuffling across and then shoulders arms.
Nice and full around off, Amla gets forward and quietly defends it near his front pad.
On a length and outside off, Amla gets forward with a tentative front foot movement and then defends it to the off side.
Good line from Amir. Keeps it full and around off, Markram also is quite confident in his front foot defense.
Fails to work it around the corner. This one is served on his pads, Markram tries tucking it on the leg side but fails to middle his shot.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Aiden pushes his weight on the back leg and pats it down towards point.
Just ahead of a length this time, angling across the right-hander, it's around off and Markram is on the front foot in his defense.
A length ball on middle and off, Markram gets on the back foot and defends it towards the bowler.
Bouncer around leg, Markram ducks underneath it.
Gentle hands. Goes back to a length ball and taps it down in the gap at covers for a quick single.
Markram has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a length around off, Markram stays back to play it down towards point.
This one is fuller and on the pads, Amla turns it off his pads behind square leg  for one.
Amla has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish on off, punched to sweeper cover for a brace. Amla is off the mark.
Fuller length ball moving back into the batsman, Markram defends it to end the over.

Chance goes down begging! In and out of short leg's hands! Shan Masood is the culprit. Good length ball on middle, Aiden plays the flick shot but fails to keep it down. Also, he has played it straight to Masood who reacts late. It hits him on the right hand (near the elbow), ricochets on his body and then goes down. Nervy period for Aiden.
A length ball on middle and off, Markram firmly gets behind the line and defends.
A touch short around off, Markram rocks back inside the crease and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Full and wide outside off, Aiden shoulders arms.
Goes back to get on top of the bounce of a length delivery and plays it down to covers.
Another front foot defense by Amla, a watchful one by him to end a successful over for Pakistan.
Right on the money for the new batsman. Slants in a length ball on off, Amla is on the front foot in defense.
Hashim Amla walks in next at number 3.

OUT! There you go! Excellent delivery by Abbas and he has hunted down the stand-in skipper. Angles across a good length delivery outside off, Elgar has his feet glued to the crease as he hangs his bat out tentatively. It catches a thin outside edge and goes into the safe gloves of Sarfraz. Usually, Dean is a very patient batsman but his patience lasted only two balls, left the previous ones and edged the third. Early success for Pakistan and it's a big one too.
Outside off, left alone.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Elgar gets forward to reach out for it and then drives it down through mid off for the first boundary of this Test match.
Mohammad Abbas to operate from the other end.
On a length and around off, Markram gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Left alone. This time Amir takes a length delivery away with the angle. It's around off and Markram leaves it on merit.
A hint of inward swing this time into the right-hander, Markram stays back and defends it in front of short leg.
Gets full and outside off, Dean gets forward and pushes it gently in the gap at covers for a run.
Angles away a length delivery outside off, Elgar watches the line closely and makes a leave.
Starts with a good length delivery on middle, a hint of shape and bounce, Markram fails to work it around and it goes off his pads towards backward square leg. They cross.

Time to get underway! The players are on the field. Dean Elgar and Aiden Markram (who passed his fitness test) are the Protea openers. Mohammad Amir to kick off proceedings with the new cherry. All set, here we go...

A milestone for the 23-year old Zubayr Hamza. He becomes the 100th Test player for South Africa since readmission. He's a very promising young batsman who averages a shade above 49 in the First Class cricket.

Toss - Dean Elgar wins the toss and SOUTH AFRICA WILL BAT! As expected, Zubayr Hamza takes Faf du Plessis' place in the playing XI while the rest of the team remains the same. Pakistan, on the other hand, have made as many as three changes. Shadab Khan, Faheem Ashraf and Hasan Ali come in for Yasir Shah, Shaheen Afridi and Fakhar Zaman.

Welcome one and all for the third Test match between South Africa and Pakistan in Johannesburg. The hosts only took 6 days and around 30 minutes to take an unassailable lead in the series and now it's time to talk about playing for pride for the visiting team. The weakness in their batting is quite evident while their bowlers didn't perform to full potential in the last game. Will they take inspiration from their Asian rival's performance in Australia and avoid a whitewash? Only time will tell. For South Africa, Faf du Plessis will be missing as he's serving a one-match ban and Dean Elgar will be leading the hosts in his absence. It's unlikely there will be any other change for them. Stay tuned for more updates...
